purpose: Teach: 役に立ち/即時/役場/強固/着信/インセンティブ/力量/上京

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯講座、市民に、役に立ちますように、企画させていただきました。
lines.en: We've put together a crime prevention seminar specifically for residents. We hope it proves useful.
lines.style: Even, official tone. Clear pacing. Slight formal formality—a measured opening. Warm underneath the procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。緊急時、即時、警察への通報、社員、訓練しております。
lines.en: Yes. Our staff are trained to report emergencies to the police immediately.
lines.style: Alert but composed. Nodding assent in the rhythm. Efficient, no wasted words. Earnest in the execution.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 町の役場と連携、地域防犯、強化してまいります、来期も。
lines.en: We'll continue to strengthen neighborhood crime prevention by working closely with the municipal office in the next term as well.
lines.style: Steady official cadence. The kind of promise that expects to be remembered. Declarative, not defensive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社屋、強固なセキュリティ、構築済みです、警察様、安心ください。
lines.en: Yes. We've already built solid security systems into our building. Please rest assured, officer.
lines.style: Reassurance with a light formality. Not boastful—matter-of-fact delivery. Respectful nod in the tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害者からの着信、警察、二十四時間、受け付けております。
lines.en: We accept victim calls at the police station twenty-four hours a day.
lines.style: Direct statement of fact. No elaboration. The kind of clear procedural information you want to land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。情報提供者、インセンティブ制度、警察、設けていらっしゃいますね。
lines.en: Yes. The police have set up an incentive system for people who provide information, haven't they.
lines.style: Attentive follow-up. Light recognition in the delivery—he's been listening carefully. Slight deference in phrasing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 担当官の力量、本件捜査でも、発揮されました、感謝しております。
lines.en: The detective's skill really showed in this case. We're grateful for that.
lines.style: Sincere gratitude without effusiveness. A slight lean forward in the tone. Specific enough to feel genuine.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地方出身警察官、上京して、首都治安、守っていらっしゃいますね。
lines.en: Yes. Those officers who come from the countryside and move to Tokyo—they're doing real work protecting the capital's safety.
lines.style: Genuine respect. Slower pace on this one, like he's really thinking it through. Admiration without flattery.
